title: Broken Heart Over Abyss
description: A surreal scene shows a large broken heart made of crystalline shards and dark chains hanging from above over a circular pool of dark water with concentric ripples. Below the heart, an open book with glowing pages floats on the water's surface while a skeletal serpent coils around the pool's edge, all set against a dramatic twilight sky with flying white butterflies.
prompt: surreal symbolic scene of a large broken crystalline heart suspended by heavy chains dripping liquid into a circular pool of dark rippling water, an open ancient book with glowing pages floating on the surface, a skeletal serpent coiled around the pool edge, white butterflies flying upwards into a dramatic twilight sky with orange clouds, dark fantasy atmosphere, intricate details, symbolic composition
